passage.label: Consideration of those disputing the signs and how they are averted; deniers of the Book and the messengers' message will know when shackles and chains drag them through boiling water into the Fire; asked where their associates are, they answer that these departed and that they previously invoked nothing, thus disbelievers led astray; told this was for exulting without right and insolence; eternal entry through Hell's gates as the wretched residence of the arrogant; patience with the true promise whether some promised punishment is shown or he is taken in death, since return is to Him; prior messengers related and unrelated, none bringing a sign except by permission, and when the command comes it is concluded in truth with falsifiers losing; grazing animals made for riding and eating with other benefits and needs fulfilled upon them and ships, carried on both; signs shown with the challenge which sign is denied; travel showing more numerous and stronger predecessors unavailing in earnings and impressions; rejoicing in their own knowledge when messengers brought proofs, then enveloped by what they ridiculed; belief declared only on seeing punishment, never benefiting once seen, as the established way of Allah among His servants, and the disbelievers losing

arabicExcerpts.text: أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أَنَّىٰ يُصۡرَفُونَ
ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَبِمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا بِهِۦ رُسُلَنَاۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
إِذِ ٱلۡأَغۡلَٰلُ فِيٓ أَعۡنَٰقِهِمۡ وَٱلسَّلَٰسِلُ يُسۡحَبُونَ
فِي ٱلۡحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِي ٱلنَّارِ يُسۡجَرُونَ
ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تُشۡرِكُونَ
مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۖ قَالُواْ ضَلُّواْ عَنَّا بَل لَّمۡ نَكُن نَّدۡعُواْ مِن قَبۡلُ شَيۡـٔٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
ذَٰلِكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَفۡرَحُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَمۡرَحُونَ
ٱدۡخُلُوٓاْ أَبۡوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَى ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
فَٱصۡبِرۡ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞۚ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي نَعِدُهُمۡ أَوۡ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيۡنَا يُرۡجَعُونَ

وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلٗا مِّن قَبۡلِكَ مِنۡهُم مَّن قَصَصۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ وَمِنۡهُم مَّن لَّمۡ نَقۡصُصۡ عَلَيۡكَۗ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأۡتِيَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ قُضِيَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلۡمُبۡطِلُونَ
ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمَ لِتَرۡكَبُواْ مِنۡهَا وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَلِتَبۡلُغُواْ عَلَيۡهَا حَاجَةٗ فِي صُدُورِكُمۡ وَعَلَيۡهَا وَعَلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ تُحۡمَلُونَ
وَيُرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ فَأَيَّ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُنكِرُونَ

أَفَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَانُوٓاْ أَكۡثَرَ مِنۡهُمۡ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةٗ وَءَاثَارٗا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَرِحُواْ بِمَا عِندَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡاْ بَأۡسَنَا قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَحۡدَهُۥ وَكَفَرۡنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهِۦ مُشۡرِكِينَ
فَلَمۡ يَكُ يَنفَعُهُمۡ إِيمَٰنُهُمۡ لَمَّا رَأَوۡاْ بَأۡسَنَاۖ سُنَّتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِي قَدۡ خَلَتۡ فِي عِبَادِهِۦۖ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ

mainSubject.label: The aversion of disputers examined; deniers of the Book and messengers dragged in shackles through boiling water into fire; the interrogation of vanished associates answered by the admission of invoking nothing, exposing misguidance; exultation without right and insolence named as causes of eternal entry into the arrogant's wretched residence; patience held to the true promise whether punishment is witnessed or death intervenes, since all return to Him; the related and unrelated prior messengers bound to permission for signs, with truthful conclusion and falsifier loss at the command; livestock for transport, food and further needs alongside ships as combined carriage; the challenge over which sign is denied; travel evidence of larger, stronger nations whose earnings did not avail; self-satisfied knowledge at the arrival of proofs followed by envelopment by the ridiculed; belief professed only at the sight of punishment declared ineffective under the established divine way, ending in loss

commandsAndProhibitions.description: And He shows you His signs; so which of the signs of Allah do you deny?

notes: Wave 6 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the travel-and-seizure argument (22) before Musa's commission opens (23); P2 ends with Pharaoh's ruined tower plan (37); P3 runs from the believer's invitation through the Fire dialogues (38-50); P4 covers the support promise, patience commands and creation signs to the Be-and-it-is decree (51-68); P5 begins with the disputers' aversion and runs through dragging, livestock signs and the ineffective deathbed faith (69-85).
